name: Konan

entries.name: Iconic Focus
entries.text: You cannot lose concentration from damage. Saving throws against chakra disruption are made with advantage.

entries.name: Scattershot
entries.text: Ninjutsu attack rolls apply to other creatures of your choice within 5 ft. of the target.

entries.name: Ricochet
entries.text: On a missed Ninjutsu, you may spend double the CP to reroll the attack once.

entries.name: Shikigami Techniques
entries.text: Twice per combat, increase Shikigami Hijutsu damage by 3 dice.

entries.name: Divine Shikigami
entries.text: You gain the Divine Shikigami clan feature.

entries.name: Papercraft
entries.text: Paper-based ninja tools use your Ninjutsu save DC.

entries.name: Paper Expert
entries.text: You always have paper-based ninja tools.

entries.name: Sea of Paper Bombs
entries.text: 1/Combat. Full-turn action. All creatures other than yourself within a 1-mile radius must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC +3) with disadvantage. Failure: 30d12 + 60 fire damage (ignores DR and resistance). Success: half damage.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries.text: Move through 1-inch spaces without squeezing. Escape a grapple or restraint with advantage.

entries.name: Freedom of Movement
entries.text: Immune to difficult terrain and movement reductions.

entries.name: Paper Arsenal
entries.text: At the start of each turn or action (Elite or Legendary), create 1 paper-based tool of your rank. D-Rank: Normal | C-Rank: Greater | B-Rank: Superior | A-Rank+: Supreme.

entries.name: Caster Passive 1
entries.text: Effects preventing chakra molding end at the end of your turn.

entries.name: Caster Passive 2
entries.text: Area-effect jutsu (Cone, Line, Radius, Cylinder) can change shapes: Cone = 30 ft. | Line = 60 ft. long, 5 ft. wide | Radius/Sphere = 25 ft. | Cylinder = 20 ft. wide, 30 ft. tall.

entries.name: Caster Action
entries.text: Cost: 2 Tenacity dice. Overcharge a Ninjutsu, adding the Tenacity dice to its damage. If it causes 2 or more creatures to fail their saves or beats AC by 5 or more, they are Staggered.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Make 2 unarmed strikes or 3 Kunai attacks.

entries.name: Unarmed Strike
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Kunai
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Konan may take 1 Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn to move, attack, cast a jutsu, or gain a reaction. She regains all Elite Actions at the start of her turn.

notes: The Kunai attack's damage type is printed as bludgeoning; kept as printed. The Wisdom save (+7) is lower than the other proficient-looking saves; kept as printed. Sea of Paper Bombs prints its save DC as "DC +3" with no base; kept as printed.
